biography: Senior Sales Leader with 20+ Years of Professional Experience in IT &  Infrastructure Services Industry with deep expertise in a large number of  competencies including digital transformation, networking, data center transformation, cloud migration, wireless, desktop virtualization, end user computing, security, automation and analytics. Specializes in forward thinking strategies, process innovation, and large/complex global programs; all centered around delivering business value. Areas of strength include collaborating with senior executives on business transformation to increase revenue growth, reduce cost, increase agility and sustain innovation. As a technologist, I believe that successful technology projects are correctly measured by the net effect on business metrics, and that all projects require both clear cut objectives and a clearly defined and measured execution strategy to ensure success.
